title: Developer Experience lifecycle: OKR & evaluation framework for SDKs, docs, quickstarts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Define and operationalize a repeatable OKR and evaluation framework that aligns SDKs, documentation, and quickstarts under a single Developer Experience lifecycle. This ticket owns the playbook, instrumentation requirements, success metrics, and rollout plan for Q2 initiatives.

Scope:
- Create an OKR template for DevX initiatives focused on activation, time-to-first-call, retention of SDK users, and first-run quickstart completion.
- Define a lightweight eval suite and pass/fail gates for docs and quickstarts (smoke examples, CI checks).
- Standardize telemetry events and dashboards required for the OKR cadence (activation funnel, crash/error rate, sample-run latency).
- Produce a public-facing playbook (Confluence) and internal checklist for engineering and design handoffs.

Out of scope: full automation of rollout for existing SDKs (handled by individual SDK squads), major refactors of docs platform UI.
acceptance_criteria: A documented OKR template with 3 standard objective types (Activation, Reliability, Quality) and measurable key results for each
Telemetry spec committed to the infra repo with event names and minimal schema required by dashboards
A Confluence playbook published with a 6-step launch checklist and links to example PRs and quickstart repos
Two pilot SDKs and one quickstart integrated with the eval smoke suite and passing CI checks
Dashboards created in Looker/Dash with permissions and a default view for PMs showing the activation funnel
